# Playerstack

> Embeddable video player for any HTML page. Drop one script tag, embed YouTube, Vimeo, MP4, or HLS with branding and CTAs. Apache-2.0, plugin-first.

## What it is
Playerstack is a thin layer on top of Mux's media-chrome and media-elements with a marketing layer added: branded thumbnails, click-to-load (LCP + GDPR), end-of-video CTAs, autopreview, themed controls. Framework-agnostic Web Component.

## Quickstart
```html
<script src="https://playerstack.techskills.academy/playerstack.min.js" defer></script>
<player-stack src="https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ"></player-stack>
```

## Plugins (17 first-party source packages, 15 in standalone, all Apache-2.0)

The standalone script registers 15 plugins. focus-mode and sellf-adapter require a custom build from source; scoped packages are not published to npm yet.

- `@playerstack/plugin-sources` — auto-detects YouTube, Vimeo, MP4, HLS, WebM, DASH (optional `config.hls` passes hls.js options, e.g. `abrEwmaDefaultEstimate` in bits/s to choose the HLS starting quality; unset keeps the hls.js default)
- `@playerstack/plugin-controls-policy` — theme color, show/hide controls
- `@playerstack/plugin-autopreview` — muted autoplay in viewport, respects prefers-reduced-motion
- `@playerstack/plugin-branded-thumb` — custom poster, click-to-load (no third-party cookies until click)
- `@playerstack/plugin-cta-end` — overlay at end of video (button with UTM, replay), or with `ctaEnd.at` ("start" or seconds) / `atPercent` during playback: pauses, adds a skip button (`skipLabel`); `frequency` "playback" or "session"; events cta:show, cta:click, cta:skip, cta:replay
- `@playerstack/plugin-chapters` — clickable timecoded navigation; optional `markers` (progress bar segments and titles) and `menu` (control bar chapter menu, `menuLabel`)
- `@playerstack/plugin-action-bar` — mid-video dismissible CTA banner; `hideAt` / `hideAtPercent` close the time window, `variant: "badge"` with a corner `position`; events action-bar:show, action-bar:click, action-bar:dismiss
- `@playerstack/plugin-email-gate` — pause-and-collect lead capture
- `@playerstack/plugin-saved-position` — resume watching
- `@playerstack/plugin-sticky` — corner-pin on scroll (`sticky.position`: `bottom-right` default, `bottom-left`, `top-right`, `top-left`; `sticky.offset` in px)
- `@playerstack/plugin-focus-mode` — auto-pause on tab blur (custom build only)
- `@playerstack/plugin-analytics` — beacon / gtag forwarder; `watchTime: true` (optional `watchTimeInterval` seconds, default off) sends `watch_progress` with maxPosition, previousMaxPosition, watchedSeconds, watchedDelta, duration, percent
- `@playerstack/plugin-yt-subscribe` — subscribe-on-YouTube bar
- `@playerstack/plugin-watermark` — corner-pinned logo/text overlay; opt-in `moveInterval` (seconds, random spot above the control bar), `moveTransition` (`smooth`/`jump`), `reinsert`; `text` is shown as given (host supplies viewer data); a deterrent, not DRM
- `@playerstack/plugin-custom-css` — arbitrary scoped CSS injection (Presto Pro parity)
- `@playerstack/plugin-intro-card` — pre-roll marketing splash (title, subtitle, badge, CTA, big play button)
- `@playerstack/plugin-sellf-adapter` — load config from a Sellf product endpoint (custom build only)

## Stack
Bun monorepo. TypeScript strict. Engine: Mux media-chrome + media-elements (MIT). esbuild bundler. Astro docs site.

## License
Apache-2.0 for core and all 17 first-party plugins. Premium plugins (post-MVP) are proprietary.
